calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

SELECT DISTINCT s.region, COUNT(*) as store_count
FROM dim_store s
WHERE s.is_current = true
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COALESCE(old.region, s.region) as region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) as september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
LEFT JOIN dim_store_old old ON s.store_id = old.store_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY COALESCE(old.region, s.region)
ORDER BY region

SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id, s.region, old.region as old_region
FROM dim_store s
LEFT JOIN dim_store_old old ON s.store_id = old.store_id
WHERE s.region IN ('Head office', 'Online')
ORDER BY s.store_id

FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key

SELECT 
  'Total' as category,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) as total_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.sale_date) = 2024 
  AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.sale_date) IN (8, 9)
UNION ALL
